honors.title: Ralph A. Niemann Scholarship
honors.description: The scholarship is awarded on merit and given to a person who possesses an academic standing and personal traits of distinction which emulate the high standards of achievement exhibited by Mr. Niemann during his lifetime. Mr. Niemann was head of the Warfare Analysis Department and assistant technical director at NSWC. He had many technical and managerial accomplishments during his career. He worked with a team of scientists at Harvard University which developed the AIKEN Relay Calculator Mark II, his department at Dahlgren evolved into what is considered the Navy's leading computational and analysis installations, and was a leader in the development of the Equal Employment Opportunity program at NSWC. Additionally, he was a leader in his community and provided service to the community during his lifetime.
honors.issuer: Issued by University of Mary Washington Computer Science · Apr 2012

honors.title: Alumni Scholarship
honors.description: Alumni of our Computer Science program have been generous supporters of Mary Washington College, the Univeristy of Mary Washington, and the Computer Science Department. This scholarship, funded through the generosity of our alumni and friends, recognizes that support.
honors.issuer: Issued by University of Mary Washington Computer Science · Apr 2011
